title: rosa canina f. fraxinoides
intro: Rosa canina f. fraxinoides, commonly known as the European Dog Rose, is a variety of the Rosa canina species, a flowering shrub native to Europe, Western Asia, and North Africa. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, which include the ability to treat digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an antiseptic. The therapeutic actions of Rosa canina f. fraxinoides include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help to protect against cell damage and promote overall health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its therapeutic effects and health benefits.
